    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Cutting corners will result in failure</nowiki></strong><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1142783476169441401.png?v=1" alt="dealertop80" title="dealertop80" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Deathdealer_robe_armour <nowiki>Deathdealer robes</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • Used for the passive ability to apply the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Mark <nowiki>Death Mark</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> debuff
⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023152065431744542.png?v=1" alt="ectoplasmator" title="ectoplasmator" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Attuned_ectoplasmator <nowiki>Attuned Ectoplasmator</nowiki>]<nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Demon_horn_necklace <nowiki>Demon Horn Necklace</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • To further support prayer renewal at K'ril
    • Can be substituted for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787526151978614824.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Essence_of_Finality_amulet <nowiki>Essence of Finality</nowiki>]<nowiki> for marginally faster kills
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Talent Tree Unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Tiers 1-2
    • </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Conjure_Skeleton_Warrior <nowiki>Conjure Skeleton Warrior</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434516658651147.png?v=1" alt="conjureskeleton" title="conjureskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Command_Skeleton_Warrior <nowiki>Command Skeleton Warrior</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ Tiers 5-6
    • </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Darkness <nowiki>Darkness</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Prayers</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Soul_Split <nowiki>Soul split</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sorrow <nowiki>Sorrow</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • You will need to periodically use your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656426717505650708.png?v=1" alt="ancientshard" title="ancientshard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to restore prayer
    • You can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the cost of renewing prayer points more frequently
    • You may also have to take a few sips of a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Prayer#Prayer-restoring_potions <nowiki>prayer-restoring potion</nowiki>]<nowiki> throughout the hour depending on damage taken
    • For K'ril: use your overload or prayer restoration </nowiki><u><nowiki>after</nowiki></u><nowiki> entering the instance as your prayer will be drained
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Your </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Ripper_Demon_(familiar) <nowiki>Ripper Demon</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> does </nowiki><u><nowiki>not</nowiki></u><nowiki> require scrolls
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Corrupted_slayer_helmet <nowiki>Slayer Helmet</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (preferably on </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Slayer_helmet_stand <nowiki>Anachronia Stand</nowiki>]<nowiki>)
    • Provides bonuses against K'ril when on a Greater Demon task
    • Provides bonuses against Kree when on an Aviansies task
⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594794631198.png?v=1" alt="intimidationtotem" title="intimidationtotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Totem_of_Intimidation <nowiki>Totem of Intimidation</nowiki>]<nowiki>
    • To reduce the 40kc entry requirement
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The method is very similar for all four GWD1 bosses, with slight exceptions as listed above for Kree'arra and K'ril Tsutsaroth.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gear can be downgraded but you should expect more manual intervention and a lower KPH.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may have to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>manually</nowiki></strong><nowiki> attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Kerapac%27s_wrist_wraps <nowiki>Kerapac's wrist wraps</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869286640722513940.png?v=1" alt="kerapacswristwraps" title="kerapacswristwraps" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Other</nowiki></u><nowiki>
